_comment: Guided tour of the emtk TTTR image browser. Targets are the spec's attr / action names and the windows the app registers; steps that need the user to act wait (await) and never press anything.

steps.title: One mosaic per file
steps.text: The browser lists the photon files of a folder and draws, for the selected file, one tile per detector of the detector setup: the intensity image of that detector's routing channels and micro-time windows, summed over the frames.

steps.title: Load the example
steps.text: Load example simulates two small confocal scans into the settings folder, adds them to the workspace and lists them, so every step below has files to list.

steps.title: Or pick your own scans
steps.text: Your own scans are picked in the Input table: the photon images of the Datasets workspace (PTU, HT3, PT3, SPC ... confocal scans; files dropped on the ChiSurf window land there). Select them and press Use selected: the browser opens their folder and lists them.

steps.title: Pick a file
steps.text: Click a row of the list to draw its mosaic. The filter box narrows the rows by any text, the header sorts, and Rating filter keeps the files that earned stars.

await.hint: Click a file in the list.

steps.title: Look at the image
steps.text: Scroll the mouse wheel over the mosaic to zoom, drag to pan. Colormap, Gamma and the levels only change how it is drawn, never the pixel values.

steps.title: Levels
steps.text: The histogram shows how the pixel values are spread. Drag one of its two lines to set the lowest and the highest displayed level; Auto levels switches off. Tick it again to use the mosaic's own range.

steps.title: Rate and annotate
steps.text: Give the file 0 to 3 stars and write a note. Both are saved at once beside the data (.image_browser_meta.json) and the rating filter uses them.

await.hint: Click a star count under the list.

steps.title: Select several files
steps.text: Tick Multiple selection to add rows to the selection with a click, or press Select all. Copy raw files and TIFF act on the selection.

steps.title: Export
steps.text: Copy raw files copies the selected sources, TIFF writes the intensity stack of every detector window, DOCX writes a Word report of the listed files with their ratings and notes.

steps.title: Detector setup
steps.text: The tiles follow the detector setup. Open the Detector setup tab to change the routing channels, PIE windows or reading routine, then press Use setup and continue: the file list and the mosaics follow.
